character_tex: Integrable characters of affine $SU(2)_k$ at $z=1$, labelled by $l = 2j = 0,\dots,k$: $\chi_l(\tau) = \frac{q^{h_l - c/24}}{\prod_{n\ge1}(1-q^n)^3}\sum_{m\in\mathbb{Z}} \big(l+1+2(k+2)m\big)\, q^{(k+2)m^2 + (l+1)m}$, $h_l = \frac{l(l+2)}{4(k+2)}$, $c = \frac{3k}{k+2}$; computed from the graded Weyl-Kac formula and summed over the $J^3_0$ grading.
description: $E_6$ invariant of $SU(2)_{10}$ (Cappelli-Itzykson-Zuber). Blocks are $SU(2)_{10}$ characters and $Z$ gives their multiplicities. The three blocks $\chi_0+\chi_6$, $\chi_3+\chi_7$, $\chi_4+\chi_{10}$ are the basic, spinor and vector characters of $SO(5)_1$ (conformal embedding $SU(2)_{10}\subset SO(5)_1$), so $Z$ equals the diagonal $SO(5)_1$ partition function.
